subcategory_text: Data are processed to limit the identification of individuals (e.g., de-identification privacy techniques, tokenization).
implementation_examples: Apply de-identification techniques (pseudonymisation, tokenisation, k-anonymity, differential privacy) to limit the identification of individuals
Document the de-identification method, its parameters, and the residual re-identification risk
Re-evaluate the residual risk when the threat landscape or the data changes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether de-identification techniques are applied
Determine whether the technique is documented with parameters
Determine whether residual re-identification risk is estimated
Determine whether the technique is re-evaluated on relevant change
